verdictEs: Seamless Co-op si tu grupo tiene más de 3 amigos; Fun is Allowed si juegas solo o duo y necesitas balance fix para hacer Nightreign viable.
verdictEn: Seamless Co-op if your group has more than 3 friends; Fun is Allowed if you play solo or duo and need a balance fix to make Nightreign viable.

useCases.reasonEs: Seamless Co-op extiende el party limit beyond vanilla 3. Fun is Allowed no aplica — el target es solos/duos, no grupos grandes.
useCases.reasonEn: Seamless Co-op extends party limit beyond vanilla 3. Fun is Allowed doesn't apply — it targets solos/duos, not large groups.

useCases.reasonEs: Fun is Allowed rebalancea stats para solo viability. Seamless Co-op asume que vas a tener party.
useCases.reasonEn: Fun is Allowed rebalances stats for solo viability. Seamless Co-op assumes you'll have a party.

useCases.labelEn: Balanced duo without a third player
useCases.reasonEs: Fun is Allowed específicamente targets duo balance. Seamless Co-op permite duos pero sin ajustar dificultad.
useCases.reasonEn: Fun is Allowed specifically targets duo balance. Seamless Co-op enables duos but doesn't adjust difficulty.

useCases.reasonEs: Seamless permite closed groups via password. Fun is Allowed cambia stats — incompatible con vanilla online.
useCases.reasonEn: Seamless enables closed groups via password. Fun is Allowed changes stats — incompatible with vanilla online.

useCases.reasonEs: Fun is Allowed es compatible con Seamless Co-op — podes usar ambos. La diferencia es que Fun is Allowed es necesario solo si quieres balance fixes adicionales.
useCases.reasonEn: Fun is Allowed is Seamless Co-op-compatible — you can use both. The difference is that Fun is Allowed is only needed if you want extra balance fixes.
